root.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Miles Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 d5 4. Nc3 Be7 5. Bg5 O-O 6. Qc2

overview: In the Orthodox QGD White plays 6.Qc2 after Bg5, Nf3 and Black castling, an alternative to 6.e3. Black usually answers ...Nbd7 or ...c5 and prepares to free the position, while White keeps a small space edge. The game is slow with no early tactics.

white_ideas.idea: Qc2 to support e4 and the c-file
Rd1 and e3 or e4 breaks

black_ideas.idea: Trade pieces to relieve the cramp

typical_structures.structure: Orthodox QGD pawns on d5/e6 against c4/d4 with Black's c8 bishop passive

character.notes: Orthodox QGD, among Black's most reliable replies to 1.d4.

gambit.notes: No material is given on purpose in the main line.

structure.notes: Centre tension; QGD anchored as Flexible.

character.reason: Orthodox QGD is the model of a Solid defence.
